answers.how: Near 1.0 s, the boat moves about 191 px/s and the shark about 114.5 px/s. Boat speed = 3 × 191/114.5.
The boat is about 382 px long. Using the shark-derived scale, length = 382 × 3/114.5.
The shark is about 124 px long. Length = 124 × 3/114.5.
The shark spans about 46 px vertically, including its fins. Height = 46 × 3/114.5.
